keyPoints: Water vapour condensed in a condenser

items.proposedAnswer: A neuron has a cell body with a nucleus and long thin extensions. Short branched dendrites receive impulses and a long axon carries the impulse over long distances to other cells, so a neuron can carry messages quickly throughout the body.

Distinguish between the universal gravitational constant G and the acceleration due to gravity g.
items.proposedAnswer: G is a constant with the same value everywhere in the universe (6.67 × 10^-11 N m²/kg²). The value of g is about 9.8 m/s² on the surface of the Earth and changes from place to place, for example with height and on other planets.

items.q: An object weighs 10 N on the Earth. Find its mass and its weight on the Moon, where gravity is one-sixth of the Earth's. (g = 10 m/s² on Earth)
items.proposedAnswer: Mass = weight / g = 10 / 10 = 1 kg, which is the same on the Moon. Weight on the Moon = 10 / 6 = about 1.67 N.
